Name: Many Much Trash
Author: lungora
Description:
Adding 50 new items to the game, all found as or through Trash items!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/14Mcunx.png[/img]﻿

Support for:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats by Tiakall. [/url]

Having trouble finding all the items, or want to try to best use some of them? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39079]Fish Trap and Garbage Net by Chocolatte12[/url] to net up location specific trash from the various watery bodies of the valley! There's unique stuff everywhere so go looking!

This trash was made to be found the good ol fashioned way, by scrounging through bins and on accident while fishing. [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/11wfjSG1DME9cYgGADmveqGL1Okru1OLtF9i59z2DcPY/edit?usp=sharing]But if you want it spoiled, there is a spreadsheet[/url]. Warning, it removes all the adventure.

More modded NPC gift tastes.
